speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: Do the gesture again, Master Burbage. Slowly.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: You have seen it. It is the one I use for Richard of Gloucester, or the man is only a clerk with a title.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: I have seen the tear. I have not seen the size of it. Again.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: There. Look at my two hands. That is the cloth the elbow spent. Not a sermon. The width of my two hands.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: She measured you, Master Burbage. With her two hands. I am glad of it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Peace, Sam. You are here to see, not to help the measuring.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The gesture is the man. A smaller one is a smaller duke.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: It is a sleeve. The duke is your business. The cloth is mine.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Make the entrance a step later. The tear is arguing with the door. The door can move. The sleeve should not have to.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: Changing a direction is cheaper than changing a sleeve, Master Shakespeare, only if somebody tells me before the cutting.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am telling you now, before any cutting. The step is later. The sleeve is yours.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: You are moving my entrance to save the cloth between her hands.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am moving it because the later step is the truer one. The cloth is Edith's argument. The step is mine. They happen to agree.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: He does not mind it, when the correction is cloth and not a line. I can see that from here.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Peace, Sam. You will be measured yourself one day, and you will like it less.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: The third time, Master Burbage. Smaller.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Smaller, then.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I like it better so. The man is still the man. The arm does not spend the sleeve.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: Then that is the one. I will take the sleeve to the light. Do not improve it while my back is turned.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: We will not. Sam, you will keep the smaller, and not the tear.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: The smaller. The lesson was her hands.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: Tell me before you move a door again. I cut once.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: You heard her. The third time is the gesture.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: The pins stay with me until the sleeve is quiet.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The entrance is later. The share will want us in a little.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: May I see the pins.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: You may see them when they are in the cloth. Stand there.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Stand, Sam. Leave the entrance where you have just put it, Will. I like the smaller.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The smaller stands. The sleeve is yours until you give it back.
